characterList.description: A person with brown skin, wearing an orange sweater. They are holding a blue pen and writing on a lined notebook.
characterList.name: Teacher

content_metadata.description: An educational video where a teacher explains the different types of RNA, their roles, and examples.

qAndA.question: What is the first example given for a plant virus that has RNA as its genetic material?

qAndA.answer: A middle man between DNA and polypeptides (proteins).
qAndA.question: What does non-genetic RNA act as?
How many types of non-genetic RNA are listed?

qAndA.answer: Factual. The teacher presents information about types of RNA and their roles in a direct, informative manner.

activities.description: Drawing a curly bracket and writing 'Genetic RNA' and 'Non-Genetic RNA'
Writing 'Some plants & animal viruses' and underlining 'Plant & animal viruses'
Writing bullet points, 'Plants,' 'TMV,' 'Wound Tumor virus,' and 'ss-RNA'
Writing 'Bacteriophage' and 'Virus,' 'Some viroids,' 'Potato spindle tuber viroid,' 'ss-RNA,' and circling and labeling '(RNA)'
Drawing an arrow and writing 'RNA' after 'Non-Genetic RNA'
Drawing an arrow and writing 'DNA' under 'RNA'
Drawing an arrow and writing 'Poly peptide' and '(Proteins)'
Writing '- r RNA,' '- m RNA,' and '- t RNA'

characterInteraction.description: The teacher is the only character and addresses the viewer directly.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The teacher emphasizes that RNA is the genetic material in only a few organisms, mostly plants and animal viruses. Relevant explanations on non-genetic RNA as a messenger between DNA and proteins.

narrativeProgression.description: The teacher explains the two main types of RNA, genetic and non-genetic.
Explanation of examples of plant and animal viruses with RNA as genetic material.
Introduction of non-genetic RNA, explaining it as a messenger between DNA and proteins.
Listing of three types of non-genetic RNA: rRNA, mRNA, and tRNA.

scenes.title: Introduction to RNA Types

climax.description: There isn't a clear climax in this video, as it presents factual information rather than a narrative story.

storylines.description: The teacher presents the two main classifications of RNA (genetic and non-genetic) and explains the role and examples of each type.

content_metadata.title: RNA Types and Functions - Educational Video
